newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 182-day bills average accepted yield 5.36 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 182-day bills average accepted yield 5.36 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 182-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 5.36 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.
This compares with the six-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate (HIBOR) of 6.06771 percent at 0300 GMT. Bids for the HK$1.0 billion issue were HK$3.79 billion.

The average accepted yield of 91-day Exchange Fund bills was 5.22 percent at another tender on Tuesday. This compared with the three-month HIBOR of 5.89063 percent at 0300 GMT. Bids for the HK$2.0 billion issue were HK$6.4 billion.

The average accepted yield of 28-day Exchange Fund bills at another tender on Tuesday was 5.11 percent. This compared with one-month HIBOR at 5.78125 percent at 0300 GMT. Bids for the HK$5.0 billion issue were HK$12.57 billion.
